articles.summary: Rinzimetostat 400 mg once daily selected as RP3D in combination with darolutamide for Himalayas-1 global Phase 3 registrational trial in post-abiraterone mCRPC, with initiation expected in 1H 2026 At a median follow-up of ~5 months, landmark 5-month rPFS of 84% is consistent with competitor PRC2
articles.title: ORIC® Pharmaceuticals Reports Selection of Rinzimetostat RP3D in Combination with Darolutamide for Himalayas-1 Phase 3 Global Study with Dose Optimization Data Supporting Its Potential Best-in-Disease Profile
